```lean
theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (n + 1) ^ 2 := by
  induction n with d hd
  · simp [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
  · have h_sum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1 + 1), (2 * i + 1) = (d + 1 + 1) ^ 2 :=
      by rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hd, add_assoc, mul_add, add_mul, one_add, two_mul, nat.add_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at h_sum
    simp [h_sum, add_assoc, mul_add, add_mul, one_add, two_mul, nat.add_one]
```
